card.name: Verbs of drug interaction effects
card.fires_on: Verbs like reduced, decreased or increased that follow a drug name (often after may or significantly) in drug interaction statements, right before the affected drug's level or effect is named.

modes.label: Interaction verb
modes.description: A verb saying one drug raises or lowers the level or effect of another drug.
modes.example: Oxcarbazepine tablets may<< decrease>> the effectiveness of hormonal contraceptives.

modes.label: Other relation verbs
modes.description: Occasional non-drug text where a verb or preposition links two things in a relationship.
modes.example: a sign must have a real physical connection with the thing it signifies so as to be affected<< by>> that thing.

card.writes: It seems to prepare the model to name the object affected by the interaction, not words about the relationship itself.
card.plain: It fires on the verb in sentences like 'drug A may increase levels of drug B'.
